glossary.definition: The maximum number of tokens an LLM can process in a single request.

Multi-level compression where each level summarizes the one below it.
The persistent long-term memory of a story state in the Continuum Flow architecture.
Character Consistency Maintenance System; the logic that prevents identity morphing.
A visual/numerical embedding that anchors a character's appearance.
The fixed duration limit (e.g., 8s) of generative video models.
The algorithmic process of estimating visual duration from written text.
Abstract Story Tree; a structured representation of the story elements.
Identifying and retaining only critical definitions while discarding implementation/flavor details.
